module GenericFunctionIdentity

function identity<T>(x: T) returns T
    requires T is Equatable
    ensures result = x
is
    return x
end identity

procedure main()
is
    let x: Integer = identity<Integer>(1)
    let text: String = identity<String>("ok")
    check x = 1
    check text = "ok"
end main

end GenericFunctionIdentity
